More precise and convenient watering for orchids and house plants. A transparent watering funnel with a volume of 1.2 liters, designed with a long and narrow spout that allows the water to be directed directly to the planting bed. The transparent structure allows you to easily see the amount of water remaining in the funnel and to better control the amount of pouring. Product advantages Long and precise nozzle: allows you to reach the substrate even between the orchid leaves. Controlled irrigation: helps direct the flow of water to the root zone and avoid unnecessary wetting of the leaves and flowers. Transparent body: allows you to see the water level while filling and watering. Comfortable handle: provides a stable grip and good control when pouring. Easy and convenient to use: suitable for regular care of orchids and a variety of house plants. Useful volume: 1.2 liter capacity for convenient home irrigation. שאלות נפוצות על ורמיקוליט 3U ותערובות שת: Frequently asked questions about 3U vermiculite and planting mixes What is the main difference between vermiculite and perlite in planting mixes? Although both materials are expanded volcanic minerals that help aerate the substrate, their hydraulic function is opposite and complementary. Perlite is a hard material with external porosity that is mainly designed to create air spaces and drain excess water quickly out of the pot. On the other hand, vermiculite is a material with a spongy layered structure, whose main function is actually to absorb water and nutrients (like fertilizer) and release them gradually to the roots of the plant as needed. Combining both together in planting mixes creates the perfect balance between excellent drainage and controlled moisture. Is vermiculite suitable for use in hydroponics systems and germination media? Absolutely yes. Vermiculite 3U is considered a completely sterile material, free from soil diseases, fungi or weed seeds, and is therefore very popular as a medium for germinating tender seeds and propagating cuttings. In hydroponic systems (especially detached substrate methods), vermiculite is used as a permanent additive that maintains constant moisture around the root neck and prevents rapid drying of the system in the event of a water flow interruption. Does the material break down or erode over time in the soil? Vermiculite is a very stable inorganic mineral, which means it does not break down, rot or decompose like organic components (such as compost or coir). It maintains its airy and spongy structure inside the planter for several consecutive seasons. However, in repeated rounds of massive planting or following strong and prolonged physical pressure, the grains may wear out a little, so it is recommended to refresh the amount of vermiculite when renewing planting mixes in pots.

How is it recommended to store the sack if I didn't use all 100 liters at once? Since it is a natural, inorganic and sterile mineral, the material does not deteriorate, does not grow mold and does not attract pests even during prolonged storage periods. שאלות נפוצות על אגרימיקס 40-40-20 אדמה ק: Frequently asked questions about Agrimix 40-40-20 light soil and planting mixes Why is the mixture called "light soil" and does it contain normal soil from the field? The term "light soil" in the world of professional gardening refers to the texture and physical weight of the substrate and not to the presence of clay or sand from the field. The mixture does not contain normal soil at all, but is based on a separated and sterile substrate of coconut, peat and perlite. The name "light soil" was given to it because it weighs significantly less than normal soil, does not compact or turn into a heavy muddy mass, and allows water and air to move through it very easily and quickly, which greatly facilitates the root system. Can this mixture also be used for indoor plants? Absolutely yes. Although the mixture is adapted and excels in outdoor conditions (due to its high drainage capacity and heat resistance), it is also a wonderful growing medium for indoor plants and house pots of all kinds. The sterility of the materials ensures that no unpleasant odors or soil damage will develop inside the house, and the excellent drainage provided by Perlite 4 protects your houseplants from overwatering, which is the number one cause of plant death in closed spaces. When is it recommended to start fertilizing plants planted in Agrimix 40-40-20? The peat component in the mixture provides natural primary nutrition for the new plants in the first weeks after planting. However, since it is an aerated and well-drained substrate, the nutrients are gradually washed away with the water. To maintain a fast growth rate, healthy green foliage and abundant flowering, it is recommended to start incorporating a slow-release fertilizer (granules) about a month after planting, or add a liquid fertilizer adapted to the water once every two weeks during irrigation.

שאלות נפוצות על מצע קוקוס דחוס כמה ליטר: Frequently asked questions about compressed coconut substrate How many liters of soil do you get from a 4.5 kg coconut block? One block of compressed coconut substrate weighing 4.5 kg yields an impressive volume of 70-75 liters of substrate after the swelling process with water. Its ability to swell 14 times its compressed volume makes it a very convenient storage and transportation solution for gardeners and home growers. Why is it important for this product to be washed and with low salinity? High salinity in the growing medium may delay the growth of the plant and damage the ability of the roots to absorb water and minerals. A.S. Titanium's coconut undergoes a strict washing process that ensures low salinity, which enables a safe and high-quality start of growth for all types of plants and seeds. Coconut stick to support climbing plants Coconut stick, also known as moss stick or coconut pole, is designed to support climbing houseplants and direct their growth upwards. This is a natural and healthy phenomenon called "patina". This is the clear sign that your vessel is indeed breathing and doing its job in regulating the humidity of the plant. Is a round terracotta pot suitable for planting succulents? How do you prevent the terracotta from cracking in the winter? Our Italian terracotta is fired at a high temperature which gives it great durability. However, in order to keep the round terracotta pot for decades, it is recommended to make sure that the drain is always open and that there is no accumulation of frozen water inside the vessel in extreme cold conditions.

The clay material allows air exchange and oxygen diffusion directly to the root system, which encourages strong growth and prevents root suffocation. In addition, a round terracotta pot serves as a natural thermal regulator that protects the roots from extreme temperature changes and keeps the soil cool in the Israeli summer. The porous material also helps drain excess moisture through the sides of the vessel, thus significantly reducing the risk of root rot as a result of overwatering. Aluminum frame structure Each 2-story floating table is based on an aviation aluminum frame and a galvanized steel base. &lt;strong&gt;קובייה כפולה זיגזג&lt;/str: Zigzag double cube TERRACE-IT system - a complementary component for modular garden demarcation, allows changes of direction and the creation of undulating patterns in beds and paths. Made of high-quality sand-colored polyethylene, UV resistant and easy to DIY install.
קובייה כפולה זיגזג TERRACE-IT – צבע חול: TERRACE-IT double zigzag cube - sand color Double zigzag cube is a key component of the TERRACE-IT system that allows full design freedom in modular garden design and demarcation of beds. This unit was specially designed to allow changes of direction in the garden route, creation of "snake" paths (S-Shape) and wavy demarcation instead of a slap to a fixed circle. The role of the product in a garden demarcation system. Change of direction in double zigzag cube arches allows reversal of the curvature angle (from right to left and vice versa) when connected to the arch units in the series. This is the complementary component that creates full design flexibility in the demarcation system. Wavy design (Zigzag) a dedicated solution for creating wavy and dynamic garden borders along paths or long beds. Instead of straight lines or fixed circles, the zigzag cube allows the creation of organic and natural patterns that enrich the design of the garden. Advantages of a double zigzag cube Full design flexibility - creating unique and interesting patterns Perfect structural adjustment - maintains the continuity of texture and height Strong and stable connection - without visual gaps Resistance to outdoor conditions - UV resistant and all weather conditions Easy to install - suitable for self-installation DIY recyclable - environmentally friendly polyethylene material Dimensions and technical specifications The double zigzag cube is designed to connect perfectly to all TERRACE-IT system components. The height and width are ideally adapted to connect with straight walls and arches in series. The unit is made of high-quality sand-colored polyethylene (PE) with a Stone Look texture that imitates the look of natural stone. Installation and use The double zigzag cube is intended to be a complementary component in a garden demarcation system. It is easily connected to other units using male-female connectors and fixed using dedicated fixing pegs. Important: This product is intended for completion and closure only as part of the demarcation system and is not intended for independent construction. Areas of use
חום ערוגות גינה בצורות חופשיות יצירת שבי: The warmth of free-form garden beds Creating winding paths in the garden Separating synthetic grass from ground covers Designing home gardens and demonstration gardens Projects of gardeners and garden designers Urban gardening and small public gardens Who is the product suitable for? TERRACE-IT double zigzag cube is intended for professional gardeners, garden designers, landscaping contractors, as well as for homeowners who are interested in a high-quality and professional DIY solution for garden design. Large arch unit TERRACE-IT An arch unit with a closed radius, intended for creating planting circles, rounded ends for beds and undulating terraces as part of the TERRACE-IT demarcation system. Main features: Tight circular design: a wide angle that allows a complete circle to be closed with a small number of units. Natural stone look: 3D stone texture that gives a luxurious and authentic look on both sides of the wall. Built-in connection system: includes a dedicated connection gap (Fuga) that guarantees visual continuity and structural stability between all parts of the system. High durability: made of hard polyethylene (PE), resistant to UV radiation and fully recyclable, adapted to outdoor conditions for years. Self-installation (DIY): a lightweight product designed for quick and accurate installation using built-in drilling marks. The specifications of the circuit (connection of 3 units): a combination of 3 arc units creates a closed circuit with the following dimensions: internal diameter (net area for planting): 1.20 meters. Outer diameter: 1.52 meters. The height of the circle: 33 cm. The component is developed and manufactured by A.S. Titanium, in blue-white production. עיצוב גינה יצירתי: קשת קטנה TERRACE-IT ב: Creative garden design: a small TERRACE-IT arch in sand color to create rounded lines. While straight lines give the garden a modern and orderly look, the curves and circles are what add to it a sense of flow, naturalness and softness. The small TERRACE-IT arch in sand color was specially designed for those who want to break the boundaries of the straight line and design rounded beds, decorative circles around trees or winding paths, all with minimal effort and with a completely professional result. The aesthetics of the natural stone (Stone Look) the small arch maintains the prestigious design line of the TERRACE-IT series. The color of the desert sand blends in harmoniously with the colors of the soil, vegetation and coverings common in Israel. The texture simulating a carved natural stone gives the garden a rustic and authentic look. Thanks to the stepped structure of the unit, which consists of three layers of stone with a cumulative height of 330 mm, a design element with a significant presence that cannot be ignored is obtained. Design flexibility: what can you create with arches? The small arch is a smart modular unit. Thanks to its built-in angle, the combination of several units allows you to create diverse geometric shapes: full circles: perfect for creating a stable and aesthetic demarcation around fruit trees or trees Ornamental, which protects the tree trunk and allows efficient concentration of irrigation. Semicircles: for creating beds adjacent to walls or fences. A combination of arches with straight units allows the creation of winding paths that give the garden depth and visual interest. Like all the products in the series, the small arch is also made of high-quality polyethylene. Height: 330 mm - enables the creation of low terraces or a clear separation between different heights in the garden. Width (thickness): 180 mm - ensures that the element will not move from its place and withstand the internal earth pressure.
מידות: החומר עמיד לחלוטין בפני קרינת UV,: Dimensions: the material is completely resistant to UV radiation, which means that the spectacular sand color will not fade in the strong Israeli sun. In addition, it is not sensitive to moisture, fertilizers or pests, making it a durable solution for decades. Simple DIY installation No prior knowledge or heavy tools are needed to install the TERRACE-IT. Drill Signs: The unit includes built-in markings that guide you exactly where to drill for fixing, which prevents mistakes and maintains clean visibility. Smart connection system: the ends of the arch are equipped with dedicated holes that allow a "male-female" connection to adjacent units. The connection creates a strong continuity that prevents the escape of soil or gravel through the gaps. Light weight: unlike curb stones or concrete blocks, the arches are easy to transport and place in the field, which saves considerable physical effort during construction. Sustainability and green construction We believe in design that does not come at the expense of the environment. The small bow is made of fully recyclable material. Choosing this product reduces the need to use perishable natural resources and allows you to build a sustainable garden. Main uses and designer recommendations Demarcating rounded beds: the ideal solution for separating synthetic grass from a rounded flower bed. Creating Constructed Pots: Arches can be used to create a raised "pot" on a hard surface or in soil. Preventing the spreading of coverings: keeps pebbles or tuff within the defined limits and prevents them from spilling onto the paved area or the grass. Summary: To give the garden the professional touch, the small TERRACE-IT arch in sand color is much more than just a demarcation tool. It is a tool for self-expression in the garden. The combination between the luxurious stone look, the light modularity and the maximum durability makes it the smartest choice for both amateur and professional gardeners. The device works with an electro-chemical method that utilizes the natural electrical conduction of the soil and liquids. This makes it an always reliable tool, without the need to charge or change batteries, and ready to use at any moment in the garden or at home. Why is the humidity level divided into color zones? The color zones are designed to make it easier for the user and prevent watering mistakes. The DRY zone (red) indicates that the plant needs water immediately. The MOIST zone (green) is the ideal condition for most plants. The WET zone (blue) warns of overwatering that can lead to root rot. How do you correctly measure soil acidity (PH)? To get an accurate result with a soil PH meter, it is recommended to first clean the soil sample of stones or debris. Insert the probe deep into the soil and wait about a minute until the needle stabilizes. At the end of the test, it is important to wipe the sensor with a dry cloth to prevent corrosion and maintain the accuracy of the device.

A plastic leaf rake is much lighter, which reduces the fatigue of working in large areas. In addition, the flexible plastic teeth do not injure the lawn and do not rust, which makes them more durable over time in outdoor and wet conditions. Is the rake suitable for collecting stones? The rake is mainly designed for light garden waste such as leaves and grass. Although the teeth are flexible and durable, massive work with heavy stones can wear down the plastic faster. For collecting stones and leveling hard ground, it is recommended to use a dedicated iron rake.

It transfers water and air to the soil, and is easy to cut and spread. Fix it to the ground easily using galvanized U pegs. Available in select nurseries and gardening stores nationwide. ביו קומפוסט מנופה 25 ליטר- תשתית אורגנית: Bio compost sifted 25 liters - stabilized organic infrastructure for a successful garden. Quality compost is the basis of every healthy garden. A.S. Titanium sifted biocompost is an organic material that has undergone a complete and controlled composting process, which includes a thermophilic phase at temperatures of 55-65°C and a ripening and stabilization period. The result: a mature, biologically stable product, with a homogeneous and thin texture that is convenient for work in any gardening application. What is sieved bio compost? Bio compost is an organic material obtained from the controlled microbial decomposition of plant and organic materials. The name "Manofa" indicates that the material has been filtered after ripening - a process that removes lumps, coarse particles and unripe material, leaving a fine and uniform texture that is suitable for direct use without further processing. Unlike unripe compost (green / fresh), stabilized compost does not compete with the plant for nitrogen present in the soil and does not produce gases that may damage the roots - which significantly reduces the risk of root burn. Proven benefits for the garden and the soil Improving the soil structure Adding compost to the soil creates aggregates that improve the physical structure. In heavy and clay soils - air spaces are created that improve drainage and ventilation. In light and sandy soils - the compost fills the coarse pores and increases the amount of water available to the roots. That is: one product that improves two types of soil in different and complementary ways. Improving water storage capacity and saving on irrigation Organic matter adds to the soil's ability to absorb and store water. Sandy soils that receive compost can double the amount of water available to the plant between bags. This means: less watering frequency, water saving, and less hydric stress on the plants. Slow and gradual release organic feed The compost contains primary nutrients (nitrogen, phosphorus, potassium) and secondary minerals, all bound to organic molecules. releasing them to the ground
מתרחש באופן הדרגתי לאורך תקופה ממושכת –: Occurs gradually over a long period of time - unlike chemical fertilizers that are released all at once. Burnt basalt paving stones with a Flamed finish are natural paving stones in a gray-black shade, suitable for creating garden paths, external passages, landscaped yards and combining with tuff, pebbles, synthetic grass and ground covers. The basalt stones undergo thermal processing with a flamed finish, which creates a rough surface with a natural appearance. The rough texture is particularly suitable for outdoor use and helps reduce slippage compared to a smooth surface, especially in areas exposed to irrigation, water or moisture. Natural basalt paving stones for garden paths Basalt paving stones give the garden a natural, clean and elegant look. The dark shade of the stone combines well with green vegetation, light pebbles, tuff, planters, urns and synthetic grass. Thanks to the natural and uneven shape of the stone, a path with an authentic and non-artificial appearance is obtained. You can combine the stones at regular intervals to create a neat path, or place them more freely for a natural and soft look. The stones are suitable for private gardens, courtyards, passages to the side of the house, seating areas and driveways. Rough Flamed finish for outdoor use Flamed finish is a thermal treatment that gives the stone a rough and natural texture. The finish adds depth, character and a slightly wild look to the stone, and maintains a natural feel that is very suitable for exterior design. Thanks to the rough texture, basalt stones are particularly suitable for areas where there is regular foot traffic, garden paths, entry areas, yards and areas exposed to irrigation or moisture. Its natural structure allows the roots to "breathe", which prevents disease and decay and improves the growth rate of the plant. In addition, it gives a natural and rustic look that is difficult to achieve with plastic pots. How long does a coconut basket last in outdoor conditions?
